issues.explanation: The adaptation says the Shu army entered the plank-road passage and issued mourning rites before encountering troops blocking the way. In the source, they reach the entrance and are blocked first; the mourning rites occur later after the route is resolved. This makes the handoff’s sequence inconsistent with Chapter 105’s opening.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the ending to: “蜀军退到栈阁道口，正要继续撤退时，忽见火光冲天，一彪兵马拦住去路。” Move the statement about issuing mourning rites to the later appropriate point.
